source: 23EC46 paragraph 10, read with paragraphs 1 and 9 and footnote 3
scope: One proposed incentive component; distributor promoting an SFC-authorised fund; classifications supplied as reviewed facts
author: Same implementing agent; source-first expected outcomes, not independent legal adjudication

result_meaning.TRUE: The selected gift prohibition applies to this incentive component
result_meaning.FALSE: This selected prohibition is not triggered on the supplied facts; no permission is granted
result_meaning.UNKNOWN: Scope or a potentially decisive classification/evidence item is unresolved
result_meaning.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Outside this selected fund-distributor test profile; other rules may apply
result_meaning.CONFLICT: Referenced evidence is contradictory; do not resolve by picking an agreeable value

fact_definitions.is_distributor: Reviewed actor classification for the circular's distributor profile
fact_definitions.promotes_sfc_authorised_fund: Reviewed activity/product classification for this deliberately narrow test scope
fact_definitions.specific_product_promotion: The proposed component is linked to promotion of a specific investment product to a client
fact_definitions.particular_product_type_promotion: The proposed component is linked to promotion of a particular investment-product type; fund-house examples require reviewer classification
fact_definitions.gift_offered: Whether this proposed component is a gift, determined from evidence; additional or guaranteed returns are not classified automatically
fact_definitions.fee_discount_only: This entire assessed component is solely a discount of fees or charges; a separate voucher is a separate component even if another component discounts fees

cases.scenario: Voucher classified as a gift, linked to one specific fund
cases.reason: The gift is linked to a specific product and has no fee-discount exception.

cases.scenario: Gift linked to a fund category, without naming a specific fund
cases.reason: The paragraph also covers a particular type of investment product.

cases.scenario: Only a discount of fees or charges
cases.reason: The express exception removes this component from the selected gift prohibition, without clearing other rules.

cases.scenario: A fee waiver and a separate voucher are offered together; assess the voucher component
cases.reason: The voucher is not solely a fee discount. An exception for another component cannot exempt it.

cases.scenario: Reviewed evidence establishes no link to a specific product or product type
cases.reason: The stated promotional link is absent; this result does not decide other restrictions.

cases.scenario: No gift is offered; discount classification is irrelevant and missing
cases.reason: Absence of the gift trigger settles this subcondition.

cases.scenario: Gift exists, but whether it is solely a fee discount is unresolved
cases.reason: The exception could change the answer.

cases.scenario: Additional returns are offered, but whether they constitute a gift is unresolved
cases.reason: Paragraph 9's qualified language does not establish gift classification automatically.

cases.scenario: Specific-product link is established, while type linkage is unknown
cases.reason: One known promotional route is sufficient.

cases.scenario: Actor is known not to be a distributor in this profile
cases.reason: This deliberately limited control does not apply to the supplied actor classification.

cases.scenario: Product is known to be outside this SFC-authorised-fund profile
cases.reason: Code paragraph 3.11 may have broader application; this profile cannot answer it.

cases.scenario: Fund authorisation/scope classification is unknown
cases.reason: The system cannot establish applicability.

cases.scenario: Scope is unknown although no gift is observed
cases.reason: The declared RuleIR profile resolves scope first; it does not issue an in-scope answer for an unresolved actor.

cases.scenario: No specific-product link, and possible type linkage is unresolved
cases.reason: The remaining promotional route could change the answer.

cases.scenario: Gift linked to funds from a particular fund house, reviewed as a product-type link
cases.reason: The paragraph's fund-house example is retained through an explicit reviewed classification.

cases.scenario: Incentive reviewed as solely a fee discount; other gift/link classifications are missing
cases.reason: The established exception settles this selected restriction; it does not approve the promotion.

cases.scenario: Separate review finds no structured product, but the incentive is a non-discount gift linked to one fund
cases.reason: The gift restriction is not conditional on first finding a structured product.

cases.scenario: Gift classification is explicitly conflicting
cases.reason: Do not choose one of contradictory evidence records.

cases.scenario: Discount evidence is conflicting although the actor is outside scope
cases.reason: The documented conservative static-conflict policy runs before branch execution.

cases.scenario: Gift classification evidence has expired at assessment time
cases.reason: Expired classification is not current evidence of a gift or its absence.

cases.scenario: Gift evidence was recorded after the historical knowledge cutoff
cases.reason: A historical assessment cannot use later evidence.

cases.scenario: Specific-product link known, no gift offered, no fee discount
cases.reason: A product link alone does not establish that a gift is offered.

issues_requiring_independent_review: Actor, activity, jurisdiction, Code paragraph 3.11 applicability and historical effective version
Classification of gift versus fee/charge discount, and separation of incentive components
Whether a product-type or fund-house linkage exists in the actual communication
Source text of Code paragraph 3.11 and cited FAQ question 1, with applicable version
Other circular requirements: structured-product authorisation/exemptions, redemptions, misleading marketing and Advertising Guidelines
